items: Authorization is now applied more consistently across spaces, profiles, memberships, blocks, and shared events.
Membership roles and space ownership can only be changed by people with the appropriate access.
A dedicated members page now supports role changes, ownership transfers, live presence, and an edit mode.
Tag management now includes clearer parent, child, descendant, linking, creation, editing, and deletion workflows.
Space navigation now uses a clearer text menu, with refreshed layouts for tags, members, and editing controls.
Space pages can now display orphaned blocks, and the inbox badge is directly clickable.
Space feeds, membership lists, and presence information now load through more consistent data paths.
